title: Open Farm Day
summary: Meet our horses, see a therapy demonstration and have a family picnic. Everyone welcome.

title: New Volunteer Orientation
summary: Required for all new volunteers: safety around horses, working with children, and a farm tour.

title: Saturday Therapy Sessions
summary: Weekly therapeutic riding sessions. Side-walkers and horse leaders needed.

title: Horse Health & Hoof Care Day
summary: Our vet and farrier visit the retired herd. Help with grooming, holding and cleaning.

title: Angel Arms Charity Dinner
summary: An evening of stories from our families and horses, with an auction supporting both funds.
